chunks: (Do you think) we would be paid back our due when we are dead and reduced to dust and bones?'

key_terms.لَمَدِينُونَ: indeed we will be paid back/recompensed

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'when we are dust and bones' in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse captures the polytheists' materialistic skepticism, questioning how resurrection is possible once bodies have returned to dust and bones, a state they viewed as final and irreversible. In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical challenge underscores the omnipotence of Allah, who can recreate what He originally formed, affirming that death is merely a transition rather than an end to accountability.
